messages:
sara_marketing: Quick sync — need to finalize paid search + retarget creative & budget cadence for next week's webinar. Can we lock plan by EOD? TL;DR: 3 headline variants (A/B/C), refresh retarget carousel, weekday bid pacing heavier 9–17, route inbound to webinar nurture flow.

james_growth: Budget check — we have $6k remaining for SEM + $3k retarget this sprint. Suggest shift 40% from prospecting to retarget mid-week if CTR drops. What CPL target are we optimizing to?

sara_marketing: CPL target: $120 for webinar signups, CPA flex to $150 for high-fit leads. If we hit < $90, scale. @eli_sales you'll own lead qualification.

eli_sales: Got it. Need UTMs & lead tags so SDR queue filters. Also can we add 'paid_webinar' source + 'campaign=mar23-launch' utm_campaign?

sara_marketing: `utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=mar23-launch&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={adid}` — also adding `lead_channel=paid_webinar` tag in webhook payload. Sample payload we'll push to Marketo: 
```
{
  "email": "{{lead.email}}",
  "first_name": "{{lead.first}}",
  "utm_source": "google",
  "utm_campaign": "mar23-launch",
  "lead_channel": "paid_webinar"
}
```

olivia_ops: We can route to webhook -> Marketo. Mapping: lead_owner by geo (NA -> @ben_sdr, EU -> @ana_sdr). Will set immediate 'attend' drip: 3 emails (confirmation, reminder, final reminder). Also enabling dedupe on email + phone.

marco_design: Creative status: refreshed carousel (3 frames) + 15s video. Assets in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/ads/mar23/carousel_v1 (replace with internal link). Headline options: 
- "Ship LLM features faster"
- "Cut inference cost by 5x"
- "Predictable LLM inference for prod"
Adding a testimonial slide and 2 CTA variants.

james_growth: Pacing plan: weekday bid multiplier +20% 09:00-17:00 local, reduce bids -30% on weekends. Start budgets: Search daily $600, Retarget daily $200. Re-evaluate performance Thu 10:00 PT and shift 40% to retarget if CPL > $140.

sara_marketing: If performance stalls, fallback ad set to broader 'redwood-lite' creative (lower CPA). Enable ad-level remarketing audiences after 48h site visit. @marco_design add one testimonial slide with 2-lines of copy.

marco_design: Will add testimonial from Acme and final variants by 14:00 PT.

ads-bot: Draft campaign "mar23-webinar-boost" created in test account. Preview: https://ads.redwood.ai/campaigns/2001234567-preview — let me know when you want it pushed to prod.

eli_sales: I'll update CRM mapping and SDR rotation. Once copy is final I'll prep a 30s qual script (3 must-have + 2 nice-to-have). @sara_marketing confirm final copy and cadence.

sara_marketing: Confirmed. Owners: Campaign ops @james_growth, Assets @marco_design, Lead routing @olivia_ops, SDR triage @eli_sales. Lock creatives + budgets by EOD. Go-live target: Mon 09:00 PT. :rocket:
